podcast.title: Current Role as Professor
podcast.body: Martha Ladly is currently a professor at the Ontario College of Art and Design, the same institution where Martha and the Muffins originally formed. "And last I heard she was a professor at the Ontario College of Art and Design, which is where Martha and the muffins began, we back when."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Post-Muffins Career in UK
podcast.body: After leaving Martha and the Muffins, Martha Ladly moved to the UK, where she pursued recording, joined Robert Palmer's band, and collaborated with Elbamar designer Peter Saville, known for his work with Factory Records bands like Joy Division and New Order. "As she quit, she moved to the UK, did some recording, joined up with Robert Palmer's band, did work with Elba Martin designer Peter Savil, the guy who did so much for factory records bands like Joy Division and New Order."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Work with Peter Gabriel's Real World
podcast.body: She spent time working for Peter Gabriel's Real World Multimedia production team, indicating her involvement in innovative and diverse artistic projects. "She spent time working for Peter Gabriel's Real World Multimedia production team."
